newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador banana exports up 23.5 pct in Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador banana exports up 23.5 pct in Jan-April.

text.p: Ecuador banana exports grew 23.5 percent in the first four months of 1997 totaling 1.58 million tonnes, National Banana Program (PNB) figures showed Tuesday.
In the first four months of 1996, Ecuador exported 1.28 million tonnes of bananas.
PNB added that Ecuador earned $469.8 million from banana exports in the first four months of 1997, up from $316.5 million in the same period 1996.
Ecuador, the world's top banana exporter, shipped 3.84 million tonnes in 1996 and 3.7 million tonnes in 1995.
The European Union was the largest buyer in the four months, importing 648,587 tonnes at a cost of $196 million, while the United States came in second with 344,376 tonnes for $104.1 million.
